notes: Authoritative source is the manufacturer owner's manual (shared for B064-008-01-IPG and B064-016-01-IPG), which contains a per-model specifications table explicitly listing the B064-008-01-IPG's I/O. Local console breakout: a single HD18 connector on the rear panel connects via an included combo cable kit to 1 VGA, 2 USB-A, and 2 PS/2 (mini-DIN) connectors for keyboard/mouse/monitor — modeled here as the four discrete resulting connectors since the HD18 itself isn't a usable end-user port and isn't in the allowed connector list. Max video resolution is 1600x1200@60Hz over VGA; VGA has no defined grade scale so no grade was set. The front-panel "Audio Ports" (mic/speaker) shown in the component diagram appear in a component list shared across the B064 family front-panel image but are not called out in the per-model specifications table, so they were omitted for confidence reasons (may or may not be present on the 8-port model). Power: dual redundant IEC-320-C6 (figure-8/C7-style but rated per manual as C6 receptacles paired with C13-C14 cords elsewhere in the doc — modeled as iec-c7 for the closest connector-list match) inputs, 100-240V 50/60Hz auto-switching, either supply alone can power the unit.

ports.name: Local Console USB (Keyboard/Mouse) 1

ports.name: Local Console USB (Keyboard/Mouse) 2
ports.note: Part of HD18 local console breakout cable kit
